prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct only geometry of this Ming Jiangnan small house game sprite while retaining same architecture, material realism, lime-white walls, charcoal clay tiles and fine detail, upper-left light and tiny lower-right contact shadow. Strict orthographic 2:1 dimetric footprint, width 7 depth 6. On an 1536x1024 transparent RGBA canvas, make thin ground rim vertices precisely L=(118,634), F=(818,984), R=(1418,684), B=(718,334). These are geometry constraints NOT visible labels: L→F vector(700,350) slope+0.5; F→R vector(600,-300) slope-0.5. The main doorway faces L→F. The footprint must follow this exact parallelogram, not perspective trapezoid; vertical walls vertical. Reduce object uniformly if needed to leave clear padding but do NOT change the ratios or angles. Plain small one-storey house, complete dark grey gable roof with modest upturns, white side gable, wooden door and shutter. No grid, text, annotation, coordinate labels, modern objects, people, white background, checkerboard, halo or thick diorama plinth. Output only single isolated corrected house with actual transparent alpha.

Use case: sketch-to-render. Image 1 is the GEOMETRY MASTER; image 2 is architectural MATERIAL and DESIGN REFERENCE only. Render one Ming Jiangnan small residence into image1's precise orthographic wireframe. The BLUE ground quadrilateral in image1 is the exact mandatory outline of its thin stone base: L(160,590), F(860,940), R(1460,640), B(760,290). Maintain EXACTLY the guide slopes +0.5 and -0.5 and side-length horizontal ratio700:600 (7:6). Rebuild/reproject house to this geometry; do not copy image2's wrong base. White lime walls, charcoal roof tiles, same small single-storey house with brown lattice door facing lower-left, modest raised white gable caps. Fine realistic matte game asset shading as image2, upper-left lighting. Blue guide and grey guides must be replaced by real thin grey stone rim and vertical walls; no guide, labels or lines in finished image. All outside-house pixels completely transparent with alpha0; NO glow, NO beige haze, NO atmospheric or background shadow, no ambient radial gradient. TRUE transparent PNG, ONE house. Complete roof and base fully in frame. Keep no more than tiny contact shadow contained within stone rim. No text, people, furniture outside base, or modern objects.
